title: Flask app shell
lead: Create the Flask app factory, base layout, health endpoint and trusted-proxy handling.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** auth, PWA assets, any feature pages.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Every UI slice needs an app factory, templates and a consistent layout. ADR 0015 requires that proxy headers are trusted only when configured.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
1. CSS approach: a small handwritten stylesheet (recommended, no dependency) or a classless CSS file vendored in?
2. Add Flask as the first runtime dependency (ADR 0008) and pin it per ADR 0017: confirm.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. `create_app(settings)` runs migrations on startup and registers blueprints.
2. Add a `/healthz` JSON endpoint.
3. Base template: mobile-first, large tap targets, no JS framework.
4. Apply Werkzeug `ProxyFix` only when `trusted_proxy` is configured.
5. Add security headers and a dev server entry point (`python -m larder`).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- Web shell tests pass.
- `python -m larder` serves `/healthz` locally.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
